typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT \'HDR\' AS [Record Type] 	,\'000000\' + CAST(? AS CHAR(8)) + CAST(? AS CHAR(6)) AS [Control Number] 	,\'69009026\' AS [HMO Identifier] 	,CAST(? AS CHAR(8)) AS [Created_Date] 	,CAST(? AS CHAR(6)) AS [Created_Time]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCHeaderSourceData
OLESRCHeaderSourceData sink(input(
		Control_Number as string,
		Created_Time as string,
		Record_Type as string,
		HMO_Identifier as string,
		Created_Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Control_Number = {Control Number},
		Created_Time,
		Record_Type = {Record Type},
		HMO_Identifier = {HMO Identifier},
		Created_Date)) ~> FFDSTHeaderRowDestination
